- Nothing I could check names Elodie Merriwether or any Halyard contact. That covers the knowledge brain (gbrain), the list of shared account files (it came back empty, so I found no Marrow files) and the channel list.
- Our notes describe Marrow Agrisupply as a Central team account. I suggested she check with someone on that team: Hollis Mbeki, Priyanka Sundaram or Tobias Rendle.
- Her message is saved in the brain as her own unverified claim. I didn't record it as a confirmed contact or repeat it anywhere else.

No approvals were needed, and no mail or other messages went out.
